# `m.options.trades`

<!-- Generated by `uv run python scripts/render_reference.py`; do not edit by hand. -->

Trades of US-listed options contracts (OPRA), tick by tick.

```python
m.options.trades(symbols)
```

## Plan access

Which of Massive's plans include this dataset, how recent its data is on each, and how far back its history goes, as Massive's pages state them.

| Plan | Trades (flat files) | Trades (REST) | Trades (WebSocket) |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Options Basic | Not included | Not included | Not included |
| Options Starter | Not included | Not included | Not included |
| Options Developer | End-of-day, 4 years | 15-minute delayed, 4 years | 15-minute delayed |
| Options Advanced | End-of-day, All history | Real-time, All history | Real-time |
| Options Business | End-of-day, All history | End-of-day, All history | Not included |
| Options Business + Expansion |  | Real-time, All history | Real-time |

## Columns

| Column | Deephaven type | Description | Supplied by |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Symbol` | String | The instrument, in the library's canonical symbol form. From REST: the request's `optionsTicker` parameter; flat files `ticker`: "The exchange symbol that this item is traded under."; WebSocket `sym`: "The ticker symbol for the given option contract." | REST, flat files, WebSocket |
| `Date` | String | The trading day of the row, as ISO yyyy-MM-dd text: the New York date of `Timestamp`. | REST, flat files, WebSocket |
| `Timestamp` | Instant | The row's primary time, as an Instant. From REST `sip_timestamp`: "The nanosecond accuracy SIP Unix Timestamp. This is the timestamp of when the SIP received this trade from the exchange which produced it."; flat files `sip_timestamp`: "The nanosecond accuracy SIP Unix Timestamp. This is the timestamp of when the SIP received this trade from the exchange which produced it."; WebSocket `t`: "The Timestamp in Unix MS." | REST, flat files, WebSocket |
| `OptionRoot` | String | The OCC option root, read from `Symbol`: the symbol without its `O:` prefix and its last 15 characters (expiry, type, and strike), such as `SPXW` for `O:SPXW251219C06000000`. It is never mapped to the underlying: an adjusted contract keeps its own root, such as `AAPL1`. | REST, flat files, WebSocket |
| `RawSymbol` | String | The symbol exactly as Massive sent it, on a row whose spelling the library cannot read as the dataset's class (its `Symbol` is then null); null on every other row. Present unless the session's `unreadable_symbols` is `dm.OnError.RAISE`, which fails on such a row instead. | REST, flat files, WebSocket |
| `Price` | double | The price of the trade. This is the price per share of the underlying, so the total dollar value of a trade is the price multiplied by the size and by the contract multiplier, which is typically 100 shares per contract. | REST, flat files, WebSocket |
| `Size` | double | The size of a trade (also known as volume). | REST, flat files, WebSocket |
| `Conditions` | long[] | A list of condition codes. See Options Condition Codes (https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/market-operations/condition-codes) for what each code means. | REST, flat files, WebSocket |
| `Correction` | long | The trade correction indicator. | REST, flat files |
| `Exchange` | long | The exchange ID. See Exchanges (https://massive.com/docs/rest/options/market-operations/exchanges) for Massive's mapping of exchange IDs. | REST, flat files, WebSocket |
| `Id` | String | The trade ID. Options trades do not have a trade ID, so this field is returned as an empty string. | REST |
| `ParticipantTimestamp` | Instant | The nanosecond accuracy Participant/Exchange Unix Timestamp. This is the timestamp of when the trade was actually generated at the exchange. | REST |
| `SequenceNumber` | long | The sequence number represents the sequence in which message events happened. These are increasing and unique per ticker symbol, but will not always be consecutive (e.g. 1, 2, 6, 9, 10, 11). | REST, WebSocket |
| `TimestampInsert` | Instant | When the library received the row, as an Instant: the local clock when the REST page, flat-file block, or WebSocket frame that carried it arrived, the same for every row of one. It is not monotonic and is not Massive's own receive time; on history() rows it is the download time, and in a poll() table the latest poll's. | REST, flat files, WebSocket |

`RawSymbol` holds Massive's spelling of a symbol the library cannot read; that row's `Symbol` is null, and `RawSymbol` is null on every other row. A session with `unreadable_symbols=dm.OnError.RAISE` (or `DEEPHAVEN_MASSIVE_UNREADABLE_SYMBOLS=raise`) fails on such a row instead and has no `RawSymbol`; the table shows the default session.
